analysis:
MARKET & REGIME: SPY is essentially flat vs SMA50 with a modest upward slope — a mixed regime that warrants selectivity, not aggression. Cash preservation is valid here.

PORTFOLIO REVIEW:
• AMP (+2.35%): Now at 88% of 52-week range and +13.8% above SMA200 — entering extended territory. Thesis intact (exceptional ROE, wealth management tailwinds, strong EPS revisions), but stop should be trailed up to protect gains. Do NOT add to this position.
• BR (-0.21%): Nearly flat, basing/extending uptrend at 29% range position. Thesis holds. Hold.
• MCO (-0.81%): Moody's did not appear in today's screened candidate list, which is mildly concerning. Fundamentally still excellent, but -0.81% is within noise. Monitor closely; if it cannot regain entry price within 2-3 weeks or breaks thesis (ratings business under regulatory pressure), exit.

PERFORMANCE HONESTY: A 9.1% win rate and Sortino of -11.14 demand serious humility. The systematic losses suggest entries have been premature or the market environment has been adverse. This argues for raising the bar on new trades dramatically — only genuinely asymmetric setups with clean fundamentals AND technical confirmation.

NEW TRADE LOGIC: One candidate stands out above the noise: NVDA. Revenue growth of 106%, operating margin of 66%, ROE of 117%, EPS revision of +22.2% in 60 days — this is the highest-quality business in the screened universe by a wide margin. Technically it is basing (not extended), +3% vs SMA50, 76% range position (below the 90% avoid threshold), with positive SMA50 slope. AI infrastructure capex cycle shows no sign of inflection. One focused position sized to risk ~1.5% of equity. All other candidates either have weaker quality profiles, extended technicals, or imminent earnings risk (ACN reports in 20 days). Remaining $16k+ in cash after this trade is intentional — preserving dry powder given the track record.

trades.entry_strategy: Buy at market or limit at $218 on any intraday dip toward SMA50; avoid chasing above $222
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: NVDA is the dominant picks-and-shovels play on the AI infrastructure buildout — 106% revenue growth, 66% operating margin, 117% ROE, $41.8B FCF, and the highest positive EPS revision (+22.2%) of any screened candidate. Forward P/E of 14x for this growth profile is genuinely inexpensive. Hyperscaler capex guidance remains robust through 2026-2027 with no evidence of demand inflection. TECHNICAL: Price is basing constructively at 76% of 52-week range (below the 90% extended threshold). SMA50 slope is +2.9% (trending), price is only +3% above SMA50 (not overextended), and +10.9% above SMA200. The recent sideways consolidation after the prior move suggests digestion, not distribution. Earnings are 67 days out (Nov 17), giving sufficient time for the trade to mature before that binary event.
trades.exit_plan: Exit if: (1) stop at $203 is hit; (2) earnings miss on Nov 17 causes a gap below SMA200; (3) multiple hyperscaler capex guidance cuts signal structural demand destruction; (4) price reaches $255 target — reassess whether to take partial profits or hold for LTCG. Time stop: if price has not made meaningful progress toward target within 90 days, reassess position size and thesis strength. Do NOT add to position if AMP or BR stop out simultaneously.
